accepted_claim: The abstract weighted Banach completion of rational functions or rational germs with no poles on any nonempty compact plane set has character space canonically homeomorphic to that set, under the displayed positive binomial and summable-ratio weight assumptions.
function_algebra_reading: Accepted conditional on a well-defined unital Banach function algebra with the stated dense rational subalgebra and continuous point evaluations.
excluded_claims: Naturality of the full Dales-Davie algebra without established rational density.
Injectivity of the value map or semisimplicity of every abstract completion.
Independent inspection of the exact 2019 Problem 8.24 wording.
Inspection of the Dales-Davie 1973 full text.

required_qualifications.rational_density: Essential; polynomial density is not assumed.
required_qualifications.radical: The radical equals the value-map kernel, which is nonzero in the stated singleton example.
required_qualifications.empty_set: Only the explicit zero-supremum and zero-seminorm quotient convention is included.
required_qualifications.source_typo: The inspected 2018 wording poles of X is transparently corrected to poles off X.
required_qualifications.attribution: Established rational-density mechanism credited through Abtahi-Honary and Feinstein-Kamowitz to Dales-Davie (1973).

edition_check_scope: Byte preservation, public content scope, artifact membership, and hash consistency only; no fresh scholarly-source retrieval or independent mathematical audit.
